reference: Previous 20 qualitative snapshot labels; no fine tuning, gradient updates or RL.
evaluation_rule: First two eligible candidates per arm in E05/E06/E08/E09/E11, not present in reference. Choose maximal entry-relative lift among post-close samples with openness<.6 and lift>=.05m.
roi_crop: 256x256 pixels, center x midpoint tips; y midpoint tips minus24px; resize256x256, ImageNet normalization.
classifier: Cosine nearest class exemplar: max similarity to held references minus max similarity to empty references. held if margin>=0.02, empty if <=-0.02, otherwise unknown. Fixed before evaluation labels or predictions.
main_feature: Area-weighted mean of DINOv3 patch tokens overlapping the fingertip bridge; L2-normalized. CLS nearest-reference is a predeclared secondary diagnostic.
